source: The Lean verifier (flock-verify verify --zk --partition --program) on one block's flat statement with its MUFU table reads inline (m1_unit.py's default; chunk_rows.reads serves each of these types' MUFU reads inline too, where it has any), setup included, its process's user and system CPU seconds and peak resident memory under /usr/bin/time, measured on vy-nebius-cpu-1 at checked 00d07520b3 for 11 of GLM-5.3's proof-block types at TP8, each staged and proved at one block (benchmarks/one_stage/m1_unit.py) and verified once, the median of its verifies where it was verified more than once. Each verify was a --zk session, on which Lean runs Flock.KsScope's form check, and Lean accepted every one; no type here is timed in lookup slots, the form KsScope refuses under --zk. A family's other types scale on the line through its members, through the fixed seconds at size 0 where it has one; the expert GEMMs and the all-reduces take their member's seconds; any other type the measured types' median. Converted at the core-seconds that cost one GPU-second at Nebius AI Cloud's on-demand list prices. The time goes as about 7 s, which the smallest type bounds (MoeExpertFp8GemmW, 8.2 s at 7.9 million matrix entries of its unit), plus 0.10 to 0.17 µs a matrix entry for the others.

value.verifier: Lean verify --zk --partition --program on the flat statement, its MUFU table reads inline, setup included
value.device: vy-nebius-cpu-1's CPU, the verify process's user and system CPU seconds
value.ratio_source: Nebius AI Cloud's on-demand list prices (docs.nebius.com/compute/resources/pricing): an H200 NVLink at $5.40 a GPU-hour against one non-GPU AMD EPYC Genoa core, two vCPUs at $0.015 a vCPU-hour with its 8 GiB at $0.0045 a GiB-hour
